description: This file defines the NodeCapabilityRouter class, which manages command handling by associating string commands with corresponding asynchronous handler functions that process BridgeInvokeRequest objects and return BridgeInvokeResponse objects.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A router class that directs commands to their appropriate asynchronous handlers, throwing errors if commands are unknown or handlers are unavailable.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the router with a dictionary of command strings to handler functions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a BridgeInvokeRequest by delegating it to the appropriate handler, throws if command is unknown.
